$reason: A comment standing directly in an ICU's case, in a decoration that holds nothing to land on. Angular 22.2's parser throws on it (`Cannot read properties of null`) while it builds the ICU's message, with comments collected or not, and so does the build, which calls it on the same text: the gate reads the throw as a template that does not parse, the refusal point 1 gives every template the tree cannot read. A comment inside an element of a case throws nothing, and is blanked like any other (`stop-in-an-icu-behind-a-start-tag-comment`). A pattern that took the comments out before the parse let this one through, the parser never seeing the comment the build does; read as an empty tree instead, the template would have nothing in it to refuse.
